name: Phoenix Zoo
tagline: Starter list: Sumatran tiger, Bornean orangutan, then African penguins — Asian elephants, not African.

practical.ticket_note: Summer: open at open, leave by late morning if possible.
practical.transit_note: Papago Park; car day for most families.
practical.best_start: Water bottle rule + elephants/giraffes in cooler hours.

challenges.text: Sumatran tiger: count stripe clusters on one shoulder.
Orangutan: hands or feet doing the clever bit?
African penguin: watch one bird enter or leave the water.
